reason: False L5-W admission fix discovered by genuine negative blind corpus

beforeAnalysis.vulnerability: Negative external-global protected programs were falsely promoted to L5-W.
beforeAnalysis.rootCause: CompletenessVerifier previously skipped basic blocks in static unreachable sets during global and environment scanning. Additionally, destructive function extraction during ClosureSplitter could drop blocks containing dynamic environment calls (like setfenv) prior to L5 verification. Because dropped or skipped blocks were ignored, externalInputs was empty, leading to false wholeProgramClosed=true.

admissionRulesAdded: Integrated structural EnvironmentAccessAnalyzer across whole program AST
Dual-stage AST verification: audits both pristine preSplitAst (Stage L0) and post-split astChunk (Stage L5)
Audits 100% of blocks without skipping, guaranteeing dead-code decoys with external global references are accounted for
Injected UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_GLOBAL, DYNAMIC_ENVIRONMENT_ACCESS, UNRESOLVED_ENVIRONMENT_ACCESS, and ENVIRONMENT_REPLACED_SETFENV into externalInputs
Centralized all admission criteria into FinalAdmissionGate to eliminate duplicate promotion writers

predicatesChanged.impact: Becomes strictly false whenever externalInputs.length > 0, escapingClosures.length > 0, uncalledCallbacks.length > 0, or environment is replaced/mutated
Becomes strictly false when dynamicUnobservedBlocks.length > 0 or not all reachable behavior is statically covered
Must be true for mixed closed programs (mixedClosedInfo.safeWholeProgramReplacement === true) or proven safe inlining & branch elimination
Formally computed exclusively via FinalAdmissionGate combining staticClosureGate, proofGate, replacementGate, cleanupGate, and oracleGate.

proofObligationsHardened: ENVIRONMENT_ISOLATION: Proves zero external globals, zero dynamic environment keys, and zero environment table replacements.
CALL_TARGET_RESOLUTION: Static proof that all reachable call targets resolve to known internal bindings or safe builtins.
WHOLE_PROGRAM_COMPLETENESS: Static proof that all reachable execution paths are fully accounted for without unobserved blocks.
SAFE_WHOLE_PROGRAM_REPLACEMENT: Static proof that inlining/replacement preserves full execution semantics.
